_doc: Lean Optimization Phase 3 capacity-routing config (gitignored real copy: store/capacity-routing-config.json). enabled=false is safe-by-default. Each candidate needs enabledForRouting:true to ever be used -- an external/non-trusted provider stays false until a separate owner GO. At most 2 candidates (hard ceiling). limitedThreshold is the usage fraction at/above which a key reads 'limited' instead of 'degraded'; ttlMs is the climb-back backoff used when no provider-stated reset time is observable.
